skill.aptitudes.mining.desc: Steigt durch den Abbau von Stein und Erzen. Passive Boni: schnellerer Abbau und RÜSTUNG.
skill.aptitudes.excavation.desc: Steigt durch Graben. Passive Boni: schnelleres Graben und RÜCKSTOSSRESISTENZ.
skill.aptitudes.woodcutting.desc: Steigt durch das Fällen von Stämmen. Passive Boni: schnelleres Fällen und MAXIMALES LEBEN.
skill.aptitudes.farming.desc: Steigt durch das Ernten von Pflanzen. Passive Boni: doppelte Ernte und GLÜCK.
skill.aptitudes.combat.desc: Steigt durch Nahkampftötungen. Passiver Bonus: mehr Nahkampfschaden (%).
skill.aptitudes.archery.desc: Steigt durch Tötungen mit Projektilen. Passiver Bonus: mehr Pfeilschaden.
skill.aptitudes.defense.desc: Steigt durch erlittene Treffer. Passive Boni: RÜSTUNG, RÜSTUNGSHÄRTE und Explosionsresistenz.
skill.aptitudes.agility.desc: Steigt durch Sprinten. Passive Boni: GESCHWINDIGKEIT und sichere Fallhöhe.
skill.aptitudes.fishing.desc: Steigt durch das Fangen von Fischen. Passive Boni: GLÜCK und doppelter Fang.
skill.aptitudes.enchanting.desc: Steigt durch Verzaubern am Zaubertisch. Passive Boni: Stufenerstattung und maximales MANA.
aptitudes.allocations_reset: Deine Attributpunkte wurden erstattet, weil sich deine verfügbaren Punkte geändert haben.

aptitudes.cmd.respec_disabled: Die Neuverteilung ist auf diesem Server deaktiviert.
item.aptitudes.hitscan.tooltip: Rechtsklick: Sofortschuss (%s Mana). Skaliert mit der Stufe von %s.
item.aptitudes.herb_pouch.tooltip: Rechtsklick: Heilt und entfernt Gift. Skaliert mit der Kräuterkundigenstufe.
item.aptitudes.wrench.tooltip: Rechtsklick auf einen ausrichtbaren Block: Dreht ihn um 90°.
role.aptitudes.berserker.desc: Axtkrieger, der mit seinen Verletzungen gefährlicher wird. EP: Treffer mit Äxten.
role.aptitudes.mage.desc: Reine arkane Magie: Runen, Raum- und Zeitverzerrung, Schutzzauber und arkane Geschosse. Keine Elemente: Diese gehören zum Elementaristen. EP: Arkaner Stab und Zauber.
role.aptitudes.assassin.desc: Heimlichkeit, Unsichtbarkeit und Angriffe in den Rücken. EP: Treffer mit dem Dolch.
role.aptitudes.herbalist.desc: Heilung, Regeneration und Gifte. EP: Pflanzen, Blumen und Beeren ernten; Kräuter nutzen.
role.aptitudes.lancer.desc: Reichweite und verheerende Anstürme. EP: Treffer mit Speer oder Dreizack.
role.aptitudes.swordsman.desc: Schwertmeister: Klingen, Paraden und Gegenangriffe. EP: Treffer mit Schwertern.
node.aptitudes.tough_skin.desc: +10% knockback resistance and +1 armor toughness per rank.
node.aptitudes.rage.desc: Strength and Speed for 8/10/12 s (Strength II at rank 3).
node.aptitudes.bloodlust.desc: Up to +15/30/45% melee damage based on missing health.
node.aptitudes.war_cry.desc: Knocks back, weakens and slows enemies within 5/6/7 blocks.
node.aptitudes.arcane_affinity.desc: +25 max mana and +0.5 regen per second, per rank.
node.aptitudes.fireball.desc: A bolt of arcane energy up to 24 blocks: 6/8/10 damage, splashes nearby enemies and marks the target with a rune (Glowing).
node.aptitudes.blink.desc: Teleports you up to 8/10/12 blocks where you look.
node.aptitudes.shadow.desc: Faster sneaking. From rank 2, invisible while sneaking.
node.aptitudes.vanish.desc: Invisibility and Speed for 6/8/10 s; mobs chasing you lose track.
node.aptitudes.shadow_step.desc: Teleports you behind the target you look at (16/20/24 blocks).
node.aptitudes.balm.desc: Heals 4/6/8 health and grants Regeneration to you and players within 6 blocks.
node.aptitudes.herbal_immunity.desc: Immune to poison (r1), hunger (r2) and wither (r3).
node.aptitudes.poison_thorns.desc: Poisons and slows enemies within 5/6/7 blocks.
node.aptitudes.engineering.desc: Per rank: +1 block interaction range, +10% break speed and +1 armor.
node.aptitudes.turret.desc: Deploys an allied iron golem for 20/25/30 s. Drops no iron.
node.aptitudes.battery.desc: Per rank: +25 max mana, +0.5 regen/s, higher jumps and +2 blocks of safe fall.
node.aptitudes.thrusters.desc: Boost forward and upward, with a short slow fall.
node.aptitudes.reach.desc: +0.5 blocks of attack reach per rank.
node.aptitudes.lunge.desc: Dash forward dealing 6/8/10 damage to enemies in your path.
node.aptitudes.sweep.desc: Circular strike: 5/7/9 damage to enemies around you.
node.aptitudes.blade_dance.desc: Haste I/II/III and Speed for 8/10/12 s.
node.aptitudes.parry.desc: 5/10/15% chance to negate a melee hit.
node.aptitudes.riposte.desc: For 2/3/4 s, the next hit you take is negated and returned at 150/200/250% damage.

aptitudes.role.upgrade.max_rank: Dieser Knoten hat bereits den höchsten Rang.

aptitudes.role.upgrade.no_points: Keine Baumpunkte für diese Rolle übrig.

aptitudes.ability.no_secondary: Du hast keine Nebenrolle. Drücke J, um eine zu wählen.
aptitudes.ability.not_learned: Du hast diese Fähigkeit noch nicht erlernt.
aptitudes.ability.no_effect: Kein Ziel oder nicht genug Platz.
aptitudes.cmd.role_same: Diese Rolle belegt diesen Platz bereits.
item.aptitudes.oak_staff.tooltip: Rechtsklick auf einen Block: Düngt einen Bereich von 3×3 (%s Mana).
item.aptitudes.guild_seal.tooltip: Rechtsklick auf einen Dorfbewohner: Füllt seine Angebote auf (nur Händler, 5 Min. Abklingzeit).
item.aptitudes.guild_seal.not_merchant: Nur ein aktiver Händler kann das Siegel nutzen.
item.aptitudes.elemental_orb.tooltip: Rechtsklick: Wechselt zum nächsten gemeisterten Element (wie G).
role.aptitudes.engineer.desc: Praktische und fortschrittliche Technik: Reichweite, Panzerung, Batterien, Antriebe und Geschütztürme. EP: Redstone, Maschinen, Schraubenschlüssel und Plasmagewehr.
role.aptitudes.paladin.desc: Heiliger Krieger: Bestraft Untote und schützt Verbündete. EP: Heiliger Hammer, Schaden gegen Untote, Blocken mit Schild.
role.aptitudes.necromancer.desc: Beschwört verbündete Diener, die mit deiner Stufe wachsen, und entzieht Leben. Entwicklung schaltet Blutkünste frei: Fähigkeiten mit Leben bezahlen, Blutungen verursachen und als Purpurfürst dem Tod entgehen. EP: Foliant, Lebensentzug und Dienerschaden.
role.aptitudes.druid.desc: Waldhüter: Wachstum, Wurzeln und Bärengestalt. EP: Setzlinge pflanzen, Tiere züchten, den Stab nutzen.
role.aptitudes.merchant.desc: Handel und List: Rabatte, Zusatzgewinne und Bestechung. EP: Handel mit Dorfbewohnern.
role.aptitudes.monk.desc: Unbewaffnete Kampfkunst: Eisenfäuste, Ausweichen und Meditation. EP: Treffer mit bloßen Händen.
role.aptitudes.elementalist.desc: Meistert bis zu 3 von 9 Elementen (auf Stufe 1, 10 und 20). Fähigkeiten ändern sich mit dem aktiven Element (Taste G).
node.aptitudes.divine_shield.desc: Absorption I/II/III for 8 s and Resistance for 4/5/6 s.
node.aptitudes.protective_aura.desc: Resistance for you and players within 4/6/8 blocks. Rank 3 also grants Regeneration.
node.aptitudes.judgement.desc: Damages nearby enemies (6/8/10, double vs undead) and heals allies.
node.aptitudes.dark_pact.desc: Each creature dying within 16 blocks grants 2/4/6 mana and 1 health.
node.aptitudes.raise_minions.desc: Summons 1 zombie / zombie + skeleton / 2 zombies + skeleton allies for 45 s (max 4). They gain health, damage and armor with your level.
node.aptitudes.life_drain.desc: Heal 5/10/15% of the damage you or your minions deal.
node.aptitudes.death_touch.desc: Drains enemies within 5 blocks (4/5/6 damage + Wither) and heals you for half the total.
node.aptitudes.forest_child.desc: In forests, jungles and taigas: Speed; Regeneration from rank 2 and Strength at rank 3.
node.aptitudes.entangling_roots.desc: Roots and weakens enemies within 6/7/8 blocks for 3/4/5 s.
node.aptitudes.growth.desc: Every 2 s nearby crops and saplings grow on their own (more radius and chance per rank).
node.aptitudes.bear_form.desc: For 10/12/14 s: Strength, Resistance and Health Boost, but slower. Heals on transforming.
node.aptitudes.haggling.desc: Permanent Hero of the Village I/II/III: villager discounts.
node.aptitudes.appraiser_eye.desc: Luck I/II/III for 60 s and reveals nearby creatures for 10 s.
node.aptitudes.deep_pockets.desc: 10/20/30% chance of an extra emerald on each trade.
node.aptitudes.bribe.desc: Costs 1 emerald. Enemies within 8/10/12 blocks stop attacking players for 7/9/11 s.
node.aptitudes.chi_palm.desc: Strike up to 5 blocks: 6/8/10 damage and a big knockback.
node.aptitudes.evasion.desc: 7/14/21% chance to avoid any attack from a creature.
node.aptitudes.meditation.desc: 4 s still: Regeneration III and Resistance II. Restores 30/40/50 mana. Costs no mana.
node.aptitudes.elemental_affinity.desc: Enables the passive of your active element; its strength depends on rank.
node.aptitudes.elemental_bolt.desc: Strike up to 24 blocks (6/7/8 damage) with the active element's effect.
node.aptitudes.elemental_dominion.desc: Your other mastered elements' passives are also active, at this rank.
node.aptitudes.elemental_burst.desc: Blast within 5/6/7 blocks with the active element's effect.
element.aptitudes.ice.desc: Verlangsamt und gefriert. Passiv: immun gegen Erfrieren (Pulverschnee).
element.aptitudes.lightning.desc: Kettenschaden und Blitze. Passiv: +3% Geschwindigkeit pro Rang.
element.aptitudes.earth.desc: Schleudert Feinde in die Luft. Passiv: +1 Rüstung pro Rang.
element.aptitudes.wind.desc: Starker Rückstoß und Schweben. Passiv: +3 Blöcke sichere Fallhöhe pro Rang.
element.aptitudes.water.desc: Heilender Schaden und Flächenheilung. Passiv: Wasseratmung (und schnelles Schwimmen ab Rang 2).
element.aptitudes.plant.desc: Gift und Wurzeln. Passiv: Regeneration auf Erde, Gras oder Laub.
element.aptitudes.magma.desc: Hoher Feuerschaden mit Rückstoß. Passiv: immun gegen Magmablöcke, +1 Rüstungshärte pro Rang.
element.aptitudes.shadow.desc: Ausdörrung, Blindheit und Unsichtbarkeit. Passiv: Nachtsicht im Dunkeln.
aptitudes.element.not_elementalist: Elementarist muss deine Haupt- oder Nebenrolle sein.
aptitudes.element.no_slot: Du kannst noch kein weiteres Element meistern (Stufen 1, 10 und 20).
ultimate.aptitudes.berserker.desc: 8 s lang unsterblich (Leben fällt nie unter 1), mit Stärke II, Schnelligkeit II und Resistenz.
ultimate.aptitudes.mage.desc: Ein schwarzes Loch am Zielpunkt zieht Feinde 5 s lang an und verletzt sie.
ultimate.aptitudes.assassin.desc: Springe hinter bis zu 5 nahe Feinde; Ziele mit weniger als 30% Leben sterben sofort.
ultimate.aptitudes.herbalist.desc: Bereich von 8 Blöcken für 10 s: Verbündete regenerieren und werden gereinigt; Feinde werden vergiftet.
ultimate.aptitudes.engineer.desc: 12 Einschläge in 3 s um den Zielpunkt. Sie zerstören keine Blöcke und verletzen und stoßen nur Feinde zurück.
ultimate.aptitudes.lancer.desc: Gewaltiger Sprung und Sturzangriff mit verheerender Schockwelle.
ultimate.aptitudes.swordsman.desc: 15 Hiebe in 3 s gegen den nächsten Feind, ignorieren die Trefferunverwundbarkeit.
ultimate.aptitudes.paladin.desc: Bereich von 8 Blöcken für 8 s: Verbündete können nicht sterben und Untote brennen.
ultimate.aptitudes.necromancer.desc: Entzieht Feinden im Umkreis von 10 Blöcken Leben, heilt dich, füllt deine Dienerarmee auf und versetzt sie in Raserei.
ultimate.aptitudes.druid.desc: Beschwört 3 verbündete Geisterwölfe (30 s) und verwurzelt nahe Feinde.
ultimate.aptitudes.merchant.desc: Roulette: Jackpot, Macht, volle Heilung, Goldregen, Fluch auf Feinde… oder die Bank gewinnt.
ultimate.aptitudes.monk.desc: 10 s lang unantastbar für Kreaturen, mit Schnelligkeit III, Stärke II und Sprungkraft.
ultimate.aptitudes.elementalist.desc: Entfesselt den Ausbruch aller gemeisterten Elemente zugleich.
screen.aptitudes.evolve.maxed: Diese Rolle hat ihre ultimative Form erreicht.
screen.aptitudes.evolve.boss: Besiege Wither, Drache oder Warden mit dieser aktiven Rolle
aptitudes.evolve.role_not_active: Du kannst nur deine Haupt- oder Nebenrolle entwickeln.

aptitudes.evolve.trial_incomplete: Du hast die Meisterprüfung noch nicht abgeschlossen.
aptitudes.evolve.no_boss: Du musst einen Boss (Wither, Drache oder Warden) mit dieser aktiven Rolle besiegen.
aptitudes.evolve.missing_item: Du benötigst den Entwicklungsgegenstand im Inventar.
aptitudes.ability.no_ultimate: Du benötigst eine Rolle auf Stufe Ultimativ für eine ultimative Fähigkeit.
aptitudes.blood.immortality: Purpurunsterblichkeit! Das Blut verweigert dir den Tod.
aptitudes.casino.jackpot: 🎰 JACKPOT! Smaragde, Glück und Held des Dorfes.
category.aptitudes.martial.desc: Nahkampf: Berserker, Lanzer, Schwertkämpfer und Mönch.
category.aptitudes.arcane.desc: Magie und dunkle Kräfte: Magier, Nekromant und Elementarist.
category.aptitudes.shadow.desc: Heimlichkeit und Täuschung: Assassine und Gestaltwandler.
category.aptitudes.guardian.desc: Schutz und Leben: Kräuterkundiger, Paladin und Druide.
category.aptitudes.craft.desc: Erfindungsgeist und Handel: Ingenieur und Händler.
role.aptitudes.shapeshifter.desc: Verwandelt sich in Kreaturen (durch Besiegen freigeschaltet) und nutzt deren Kräfte. Andere Spieler sehen dich als diese Kreatur. EP: Verwandlungen und Kräfte nutzen.
ultimate.aptitudes.shapeshifter.desc: Werde für 20 s zum Warden: +20 Leben, Stärke II, Resistenz II, Dunkelheit für nahe Spieler und Schallknall als Kraft.
node.aptitudes.mimicry.desc: Reduces mana drain while transformed (3 → 2.5 → 2 → 1.5 per second).
node.aptitudes.transform.desc: Turns you into the chosen form (or back to human). Others see you as the mob; your hitbox doesn't change.
node.aptitudes.trickster.desc: R1: monsters ignore you while you look like one of them. R2: you emit the mob's sounds (other players hear them too).
node.aptitudes.form_power.desc: Uses the current form's power: explosion (Creeper), teleport (Enderman), venom bite (Spider), fireballs (Blaze), flight (Bat), super jump (Slime), egg barrage (Chicken), ground slam (Golem), curse (Witch), escape (Villager).
form.aptitudes.creeper.desc: Kraft: Explodieren ohne zu sterben (zerstört Blöcke, falls erlaubt). Freischalten: 10 besiegen.
form.aptitudes.enderman.desc: Nachtsicht. Kraft: 20-28 Blöcke teleportieren. Freischalten: 10 besiegen.
form.aptitudes.bat.desc: Nachtsicht; langsamer Fall beim Schleichen. Kraft: kurzer Flug. Freischalten: 5 besiegen.
form.aptitudes.slime.desc: Kein Fallschaden. Kraft: Supersprung. Freischalten: 10 besiegen.
form.aptitudes.chicken.desc: Langsamer Fall. Kraft: Eiersalve (Streich). Freischalten: 10 besiegen.
form.aptitudes.iron_golem.desc: Resistenz, aber langsamer. Kraft: Bodenschlag. Freischalten: 3 besiegen.
form.aptitudes.witch.desc: Immun gegen Gift. Kraft: Fluch (Gift, Langsamkeit, Schwäche). Freischalten: 10 besiegen.
form.aptitudes.villager.desc: Perfekte Tarnung für Streiche. Kraft: Flucht (Schnelligkeit III). Freischalten: Gestaltwandler Stufe 5.
item.aptitudes.mimic_mask.not_shapeshift: Du musst die Rolle Gestaltwandler aktiviert haben.
aptitudes.morph.locked: Du hast die Form %s noch nicht freigeschaltet.
aptitudes.morph.exhausted: Kein Mana mehr: Du nimmst wieder menschliche Form an.
signature.aptitudes.berserker.desc: Kreaturen im Umkreis von 8 Blöcken verlieren die HÄLFTE ihres aktuellen Lebens; du erhältst Stärke III und Schnelligkeit II (15 s).
signature.aptitudes.mage.desc: 8 arkane Runen fallen auf den Zielpunkt: magischer Flächenschaden und Rückstoß. Kein Feuer und keine Explosionen.
signature.aptitudes.assassin.desc: Markiert das Ziel: Es erleidet 10 s lang DREIFACHEN Schaden von dir.
signature.aptitudes.herbalist.desc: Reinigt nahe Verbündete und gewährt Regeneration III und zusätzliches Leben.
signature.aptitudes.engineer.desc: 1. Nutzung: Setzt einen Teleportpunkt. 2. Nutzung: Rückkehr mit Panzerung (Absorption IV + Resistenz II).
signature.aptitudes.lancer.desc: 3 s lang ununterbrochene Anstürme, die Feinde niedertrampeln; währenddessen unantastbar für Kreaturen.
signature.aptitudes.swordsman.desc: Ein 14 Blöcke langer Hieb durch alle Feinde: 20 Schaden.
signature.aptitudes.paladin.desc: 10 s lang KEIN Schaden, +50 Mana, Lebensenergie III, Absorption III, Resistenz II und volle Heilung.
signature.aptitudes.necromancer.desc: Erweckt 4 Diener mit Stärke II und Resistenz II. Passiv (Meister): Deine Diener sind widerstandsfähiger und ihr Schaden heilt dich.
signature.aptitudes.druid.desc: Beim Tod wirst du wie durch ein Totem der Unsterblichkeit wiederbelebt. Einmal alle 5 Minuten.
signature.aptitudes.merchant.desc: Dauerhaft Held des Dorfes V (riesige Rabatte) und Glück.
signature.aptitudes.monk.desc: Heilt Verbündete im Umkreis von 10 Blöcken vollständig und gewährt Stärke II, Schnelligkeit II, Resistenz II und Regeneration II (20 s).
signature.aptitudes.elementalist.desc: Errichtet eine Wand deines Hauptelements und entfesselt dessen Domäne für 10 s, die alle Feinde darin verletzt.
signature.aptitudes.shapeshifter.desc: Streich: Verwandelt nahe Spieler für 10 s in Hühner und lässt Monster schweben.
aptitudes.ability.no_signature: Du benötigst eine Meisterrolle (mit aktiver Signatur), um Z zu nutzen.
aptitudes.signature.beacon_set: Signalpunkt gesetzt. Nutze die Fähigkeit erneut, um hierher zurückzukehren.
aptitudes.signature.forest_rebirth: Der Wald bringt dich ins Leben zurück!
unique.aptitudes.adaptation.desc: Passiv: Jeder Treffer desselben Schadenstyps erhöht deine Resistenz dagegen für 60 s um 10% (max. 80%). Aktiv: 10 s Immunität gegen den zuletzt erlittenen Schadenstyp und Regeneration II.
unique.aptitudes.greed.desc: Passiv: 15% Chance auf einen zusätzlichen Smaragd bei Tötungen. Aktiv: Stiehlt alle positiven Effekte von allen im Umkreis von 8 Blöcken.
unique.aptitudes.void_archive.desc: Passiv: Merkt sich die letzte Rollenfähigkeit eines Spielers im Umkreis von 16 Blöcken. Aktiv: Du wirkst sie selbst auf Rang 3.
unique.aptitudes.fungal.desc: Passiv: Deine Treffer infizieren (Gift), das sich beim Tod ausbreitet. Aktiv: 6 s Sporenwolke (Gift II, Blindheit).
unique.aptitudes.parasite.desc: Passiv: 10% Lebensraub. Aktiv: Hefte dich unsichtbar an ein Ziel und entziehe ihm 5 s lang 2 Leben pro Sekunde.
unique.aptitudes.hellfire.desc: Passiv: Feuerimmunität; deine Treffer entzünden. Aktiv: Höllennova (10 Flächenschaden und Feuer am Boden).
unique.aptitudes.chosen_king.desc: Passiv: +4 Herzen; Stärke und Regeneration für Verbündete im Umkreis von 12 Blöcken. Aktiv: Königliches Dekret (Feinde im Umkreis von 16 Blöcken fast bewegungslos und geschwächt).
unique.aptitudes.spacetime.desc: Passiv: Position und Leben werden jede Sekunde gespeichert. Aktiv: 5 Sekunden zurückspulen (Position und Leben).
unique.aptitudes.negation.desc: Passiv: immun gegen negative Effekte. Aktiv: 8 s Zone, in der andere Spieler KEINE Fähigkeiten nutzen können und Kreaturen ihre Effekte verlieren.
unique.aptitudes.geneticist.desc: Passiv: Nahe Jungtiere wachsen 10× schneller. Aktiv: Verwandelt nahe Tiere in andere Arten.
unique.aptitudes.mirror.desc: Aktiv: Kopiere die anvisierte Kreatur (jede beliebige): Werde für 30 s zu ihr und erhalte die Hälfte ihres maximalen Lebens.
unique.aptitudes.exploiter.desc: Passiv: 25% doppelte Erze. Aktiv: 15 s doppelte Beute von getöteten Kreaturen und Glück III.
unique.aptitudes.pendragon.desc: Passiv: Mit einem Schwert +4 Rüstung und +10% Schaden. Aktiv: Excalibur, ein 30 Blöcke langer Lichtstrahl (16 Schaden, doppelt gegen Untote).
unique.aptitudes.sky_lord.desc: Passiv: immun gegen Fallschaden. Aktiv: 12 s freier Flug.
unique.aptitudes.stillness.desc: Passiv: Resistenz beim reglosen Schleichen. Aktiv: Hält die Zeit für 5 s im Umkreis von 12 Blöcken an (Kreaturen und Projektile eingefroren).
unique.aptitudes.harbinger.desc: Passiv: Untote greifen dich nicht an. Aktiv: Verurteile ein Ziel; nach 3 s verliert es 50% seines maximalen Lebens (10% bei Bossen).
aptitudes.unique.granted: ✦ %s hat die einzigartige Fähigkeit %s erhalten. Niemand sonst kann sie besitzen!
aptitudes.unique.taken: Du hast die Leistung für %s erbracht, aber die Fähigkeit gehört bereits %s.

aptitudes.unique.negated: Du befindest dich in einer Zone der Negation!

attribute.aptitudes.faith.desc: Verringert die Abklingzeit aller deiner Fähigkeiten.
aptitudes.souls.rested: Du rastest am Leuchtfeuer. Leben und Mana wiederhergestellt; Wiederbelebungspunkt gesetzt.
aptitudes.souls.need_bonfire: Du musst neben dem Leuchtfeuer stehen, an dem du gerastet hast.

node.aptitudes.frenzy.desc: MECHANIC: each melee hit within 3 s stacks +4%% damage (max 3/4/5 stacks).
node.aptitudes.unbreakable.desc: Dropping below 30%% health grants Resistance for 4/5/6 s (II at rank 3). Every 20 s.
node.aptitudes.leap_slam.desc: Leap forward and slam on landing, hitting everything around you (6/8/10 damage) and launching them.
node.aptitudes.whirlwind.desc: Spin 3 times in 1.5 s hitting everything nearby (3/4/5 per spin).
node.aptitudes.arcane_charges.desc: MECHANIC: each Mage spell grants a charge; at 5/4/3 charges, the next spell refunds its mana cost.
node.aptitudes.mana_shield.desc: 10/20/30%% of each hit is absorbed by your mana (2 mana per health point).
node.aptitudes.spell_echo.desc: Killing with spells or ranged attacks restores 8/16/24 mana.
node.aptitudes.arcane_missiles.desc: Fire 4/5/6 homing missiles at the nearest enemies (3 damage each).
node.aptitudes.lethal_tempo.desc: MECHANIC: the 3rd consecutive hit on the same target is a finisher: +50/75/100%% damage and Wither.
node.aptitudes.smoke_escape.desc: Dropping below 30%% health grants Invisibility and Speed II for 3 s (every 40/35/30 s).
node.aptitudes.vanish_on_kill.desc: Each kill: Speed for 3 s and Invisibility for 1/2/3 s.
node.aptitudes.fan_of_knives.desc: Throw blades at all enemies within 5 blocks: 4/5/6 damage and Poison.
node.aptitudes.shuriken.desc: Ranged strike: 7/9/11 damage, Glowing and Slowness II.
node.aptitudes.bloom.desc: MECHANIC: after standing still 3 s, you and allies within 3/4/5 blocks gain Regeneration.
node.aptitudes.antidote.desc: Every second, 15/30/45%% chance to remove a negative effect.
node.aptitudes.thorny_skin.desc: Melee attackers are poisoned for 2/3/4 s.
node.aptitudes.healing_rain.desc: 5 s of rain healing 1.5/2/2.5 per second to players within 6/7/8 blocks.
node.aptitudes.spore_cloud.desc: A 6 s cloud where you look: Poison and Weakness to enemies.
node.aptitudes.overdrive.desc: MECHANIC: each Engineer ability adds 25 heat; at 100 you enter Overdrive for 6/8/10 s (+20%% damage, Haste II), then slow down.
node.aptitudes.auto_shield.desc: Hits of 5 or more grant Absorption for 5 s (I/II/III). Every 20 s.
node.aptitudes.field_repair.desc: Every 20 s, repair 2/4/6 durability on all your gear.
node.aptitudes.grapple.desc: Pull yourself to the block you look at (up to 20/24/28 blocks) without fall damage.
node.aptitudes.pulse_grenade.desc: Explodes after 1 s where you look: 8/10/12 damage and knockback, no block damage.
node.aptitudes.impetus.desc: MECHANIC: sprinting for 2 s charges your next hit: +30/45/60%% damage and knockback.
node.aptitudes.brace.desc: While sneaking you take 10/20/30%% less damage.
node.aptitudes.dragon_leap.desc: Leap high and dive down: 7/9/11 damage and Slowness III around you.
node.aptitudes.piercing_thrust.desc: Pierce all enemies in an 8-block line: 8/10/12 damage.
node.aptitudes.kata.desc: MECHANIC: with a sword, the 3rd chained hit (1.5 s) sweeps nearby enemies for 40/60/80%% of the damage.
node.aptitudes.reflexes.desc: When hit, 5/10/15%% chance to gain Speed II and make your next hit deal +50%%.
node.aptitudes.flurry.desc: Each kill: Haste for 4 s (Haste II at rank 3).
node.aptitudes.iaido.desc: Dash 6 blocks like lightning, cutting everything you pass: 7/9/11 damage.
node.aptitudes.thousand_cuts.desc: 5 rapid cuts on the target (3/4/5 each).
node.aptitudes.holy_light.desc: MECHANIC: your hits charge light (double vs undead); at 5 charges it bursts: 4/5/6 area damage and heals you 3/4/5.
node.aptitudes.intercession.desc: If an ally within 8 blocks drops below 30%% health, heal them 4/6/8 (every 30 s).
node.aptitudes.purifying_light.desc: When hit, 10/20/30%% chance to remove Poison and Wither and heal 1.
node.aptitudes.consecration.desc: Holy ground for 6 s: damages enemies (double vs undead) and heals players.
node.aptitudes.hammer_of_justice.desc: Stuns the target for 3 s and deals 8/10/12 damage.
node.aptitudes.soul_harvest.desc: MECHANIC: each kill grants a soul (max 3/4/5): +3%% damage per soul. They fade one by one every 15 s.
node.aptitudes.bone_shield.desc: Dropping below 50%% health grants Absorption I/II/III for 5 s (every 30 s).
node.aptitudes.corpse_burst.desc: When a minion dies it explodes: 3/4/5 damage to nearby enemies.
node.aptitudes.bone_spear.desc: A spear piercing a 16-block line: 7/9/11 damage and Wither.
node.aptitudes.soul_siphon.desc: Drains enemies within 6/7/8 blocks (3/4/5 each) and heals you for half.
node.aptitudes.day_night_cycle.desc: MECHANIC: by day you heal 0.5/1/1.5 every 3 s; by night you deal +10/15/20%% damage.
node.aptitudes.barkskin.desc: Melee hits: 10/20/30%% chance of Resistance II for 3 s (every 15 s).
node.aptitudes.summon_wolves.desc: Summon 2 allied wolves (3 at rank 3) for 40 s.
node.aptitudes.thorn_storm.desc: Thorns within 6 blocks: 4/5/6 damage and Slowness II.
node.aptitudes.compound_interest.desc: MECHANIC: every 10 emeralds in your inventory grant +1 luck and +2%% damage (max 3/4/5).
node.aptitudes.insurance.desc: Hits of 6 or more: pay 1 emerald to take 30/40/50%% less.
node.aptitudes.bounty.desc: Monsters you kill drop an emerald (5/10/15%%).
node.aptitudes.golden_guard.desc: Spend 2 emeralds: Absorption II and Resistance I.
node.aptitudes.stances.desc: MECHANIC: sprinting, Tiger stance (+10/15/20%% damage); sneaking, Crane stance (−10/15/20%% damage taken).
node.aptitudes.flying_kick.desc: Launch forward; the first enemy takes 7/9/11 and is knocked flying.
node.aptitudes.hundred_fists.desc: 8 lightning-fast punches on the target (2/2.5/3 each).
node.aptitudes.elemental_reaction.desc: MECHANIC: switching element (G) raises your magic damage by 30/45/60%% for 5 s.
node.aptitudes.elemental_barrage.desc: 3 projectiles of your active element, one every 0.5 s.
node.aptitudes.elemental_aura.desc: 4 pulses of your active element's burst over 6 s.
node.aptitudes.instinct.desc: MECHANIC: while transformed, every 10 s you gain +5%% damage (max 3/4/5); lost when you revert.
node.aptitudes.slippery.desc: When hit, 10/20/30%% chance of Invisibility for 2 s (every 20 s).
node.aptitudes.pounce.desc: Leap at the target and deal 6/8/10 damage on arrival.
node.aptitudes.beast_howl.desc: Enemies within 6 blocks take 4/5/6, Weakness and knockback.

guide.aptitudes.start.title: Welcome
guide.aptitudes.start.body:
Aptitudes is a full RPG system: your SKILLS level up by doing things (mining, chopping, fighting…), your ATTRIBUTES are bought at a Bonfire with experience, and you pick a primary and a secondary ROLE, each with its own talent tree, mana and abilities.

First steps:
1. Craft a Bonfire and rest at it.
2. Press J and choose your primary role.
3. Spend tree points (J) and equip your actives.
4. Use V, B (primary role) and N, M (secondary).
guide.aptitudes.keys.title: Keys
guide.aptitudes.keys.body:
K: attributes and skills.
J: roles and talent tree.
V / B: primary role actives.
N / M: secondary role actives.
Z: signature ability (Master).
R: ultimate (Ultimate tier).
H: legendary ability.
G: switch element (Elementalist).
Y: accessories.
O: toggle the HUD; Shift + O: HUD settings.
In the tree: drag to move, wheel to zoom, C to center. If the window does not fit (large GUI scale), use the wheel outside the tree or PgUp/PgDn to scroll it.
In the grimoire: ↑/↓ change chapter; click an item to see its recipe; Backspace or the mouse side button go back; ←/→ switch recipe.
All can be changed in Options → Controls.
guide.aptitudes.bonfire.title: The Bonfire
guide.aptitudes.bonfire.body:
Recipe: iron sword on top and, below, cobblestone + campfire + cobblestone.

Resting (right-click): restores all health and mana, sets your respawn point, refills your Estus and Ether Flasks and opens the level-up screen.

Leveling up: missing attribute points are bought as soul levels paying regular experience levels. Each soul level costs 1 + level/6 XP levels (max 10) and every 3 soul levels grant 1 point.

XP bloodstain: when you die, your XP stays where you died (soul flames only you can see). Go back for it before dying again.

Ritual: use a Rebirth Offering on the Bonfire to be able to change one of your roles.
guide.aptitudes.attributes.title: Attributes
guide.aptitudes.attributes.body:
Eight Souls-like attributes (K screen):
Vigor: max health.
Mind: max mana and regeneration.
Endurance: armor.
Strength: melee damage.
Dexterity: attack speed.
Intelligence: magic damage.
Faith: lower cooldown on every ability (global cap 60%%).
Luck: loot and chances.

Each role has 2 affine attributes (★): +50%% value if it is your primary role, +25%% if secondary.
guide.aptitudes.skills.title: Skills by use
guide.aptitudes.skills.body:
They level up as you play: Mining, Excavation, Woodcutting, Farming, Combat, Archery, Defense, Agility, Fishing and Enchanting.

Each level gives a small passive bonus (mining speed, armor, arrow damage…). Every 10 levels you unlock a MILESTONE: night vision while mining, auto-replanting, felling whole trees, piercing arrows, a second chance on death… Hover each skill on the K screen to see them.

Repeating the SAME source too often (the same mob type, the same attacker, fishing nonstop) gives less and less XP: mob farms and AFK fishing are not efficient. Normal play is not affected.

COMBOS: chained melee hits on creatures (within 2.5 s) add +3%% damage each (max +15%%). At 5 hits, your next hit is a FINISHER based on your main role's category: seismic strike (martial), execution (shadow), arcane chain (arcane), holy strike that heals (guardian) or electric overload (craft). Taking a heavy hit breaks the combo.
guide.aptitudes.roles.title: Roles
guide.aptitudes.roles.body:
There are 20 roles in 5 categories (Martial, Arcane, Shadow, Guardian, Craft). You pick a PRIMARY and a SECONDARY role (J screen); the secondary gains XP at half rate.

Each role has its signature item (using it grants XP), its own resource (Fury, Focus, Harmony…; at 50%% it empowers the next ability), an armor set and a unique mechanic.

Synergy: two roles of the same category give +15%% role XP; different categories give +15 mana.

Filling an empty slot is free. To REPLACE a chosen role you need the Bonfire ritual with a Rebirth Offering.
guide.aptitudes.tree.title: Talent tree
guide.aptitudes.tree.body:
Each role’s tree combines base nodes, a legendary node, evolution rows and deeper paths:
• Passives on the left, Paths in the center and Actives on the right.
• Each node requires at least one rank in its prerequisite; the lines show the route.
• Three exclusive paths: follow only ONE per role. The «Paths» button shows all seven steps, the level 32 fork and the level 50 keystone. See «Paths and keystones».
• Four base actives and four more from evolution: equip two per role with Slot 1 / Slot 2.
• Reactives: passives triggered by taking damage, kills or other actions.
• Legendary: level 25 node, activated with H.

Default POINTS: 1 at level 1 and 3 every 3 role levels; 51 at level 50. Master adds 10 and Ultimate adds 5: up to 66. You cannot learn everything.

EVOLUTION ROWS: Master opens five nodes (three passives and two actives, up to two ranks); Ultimate opens another five (one rank). They remain locked at the bottom of the tree until you evolve.
guide.aptitudes.evolution.title: Evolution
guide.aptitudes.evolution.body:
Each role can evolve twice:
• MASTER: level 20, complete the role trial (kills with its weapon, ability uses…) and a Mastery Emblem. Unlocks the signature ability (Z), +1 rank on its nodes and a new weapon.
• ULTIMATE: level 30, having slain a boss (Wither, Dragon or Warden) with the role active and an Ultimate Core. Unlocks the ultimate (R), another extra rank and the ultimate weapon.

The Evolve button is on the J screen (its tooltip shows what is missing).
guide.aptitudes.weapons.title: Evolution weapons
guide.aptitudes.weapons.body:
When you evolve to Master and to Ultimate you receive a new weapon for your role. They appear in the top row of the tree, beside the signature and the ultimate.

• Melee roles: a blade (diamond at Master, netherite at Ultimate) that, with the role active, leaves a sweep in its color, charges the role resource and, the ultimate one, heals you a little.
• Magic or ranged roles: an instant-shot focus (7 or 10 damage + 0.2 per role level) that costs mana.

If you lose it, select it in the tree and press Claim (only if it is not already in your inventory or Ender chest).
guide.aptitudes.elements.title: Elementalist
guide.aptitudes.elements.body:
The Elementalist masters up to 3 elements (at level 1, 10 and 20) out of 14: Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Wind, Water, Plant, Magma, Shadow, Light, Void, Poison, Crystal and Sound. The choice is permanent. G switches the active element.

FUSIONS: if you master both elements of a pair and cast Elemental Burst with one of them active, the fusion is added:
Fire+Wind: Firestorm · Water+Lightning: Electrocution · Ice+Water: Blizzard · Earth+Magma: Eruption · Plant+Poison: Plague · Light+Shadow: Eclipse · Void+Crystal: Crystal Singularity · Sound+Wind: Resonance · Lightning+Crystal: Prism · Fire+Ice: Thermal Shock.
In the element view (J → Elements) each element lists its fusions.
guide.aptitudes.armor.title: Role armor
guide.aptitudes.armor.body:
Each role has a 4-piece set. Crafted ONLY at the GUILD DESK (right-click it): the normal piece pattern made with the role MATERIAL and a Soul Shard in the center slot.

With all 4 pieces on and that role as primary or secondary, the set bonus activates (see each piece's tooltip). Weight changes defense: heavy (Berserker, Lancer, Paladin), medium and light.

They also appear in tower and camp chests, can be bought with Armory Vouchers from the guild villager and drop from champions.
guide.aptitudes.soul_items.title: Soul items
guide.aptitudes.soul_items.body:
Soul Shard: basic material. Dropped by monsters (see Loot).
Estus Flask: 5 charges; heals 8 health.
Ether Flask: 5 charges; restores 40%% mana.
(Flasks refill when you rest at the Bonfire.)
Soul tools (diamond tool + 3 shards): pickaxe and shovel break 3×3 while sneaking; the axe fells the whole tree while sneaking; the hoe harvests and replants 3×3.
Rebirth Offering: lets you change a role (Bonfire ritual).
Armory Voucher: gives a piece of your primary role's set.
guide.aptitudes.accessories.title: Accessories
guide.aptitudes.accessories.body:
Y key: 2 ring slots and 1 amulet slot. Kept on death.
Rings: Strength (+1.5 damage), Vitality (+4 health), Swiftness (+8%% speed), Mana (+30), Vampire (5%% lifesteal), Fortune (+2 luck).
Amulets: Guardian (+3 armor), Phoenix (saves you from death every 10 min), Arcane (−10%% cooldowns), Grove (heal out of combat), Hunter's Trophy (+25%% damage to elites).

Recipes: ring = 4 gold nuggets + gem + Elite Essence. Amulet = string + Elite Essence + gem (the Phoenix one needs a Champion Heart).
guide.aptitudes.elites.title: Elites and champions
guide.aptitudes.elites.body:
5%% of monsters spawn as ELITES (visible name, double health and 1-2 modifiers: Swift, Armored, Vampiric, Brutal, Regenerating, Explosive, Frost, Blinking, Giant).

Some elites are CHAMPIONS (3 modifiers, 4 times the health and a boss bar). Every tower has a skeleton champion on its rooftop.

They drop Soul Shards, Elite Essence and, champions, a Champion Heart and a role armor piece.
guide.aptitudes.structures.title: Structures
guide.aptitudes.structures.body:
RUINED TOWER: 4 floors with chests, monster spawners and a champion on the rooftop next to the best chest (role armor, soul tools, accessories).
BONFIRE SHRINE: ruins with a lit Bonfire and a chest (shards, flasks, sometimes an Offering).
CAMP: hunters, warlocks or bandits, with guards and themed loot.

They only generate in new terrain (unexplored chunks).
guide.aptitudes.guild.title: Guild villager
guide.aptitudes.guild.body:
Place a Guild Desk (gold + emerald on top and planks) next to a jobless villager to turn it into a Guildmaster.

Depending on its level it sells: Soul Shards, Estus and Ether Flasks, role materials, Armory Vouchers, Rebirth Offerings, Mastery Emblems and Ultimate Cores. It buys leather and bones.

The desk is also a workshop: right-click it to craft role armor (it can only be made there).

RUNES: hold a role weapon in one hand and a rune in the other and use the Guild Desk to socket it (two per weapon, different ones). There are Flame, Leech, Swift, Force, Frost, Thunder, Guard and the Eclipse rune. To remove the last rune: Shift + right-click the Desk with the weapon in hand and the other hand empty; it costs emeralds and the rune is lost.
guide.aptitudes.recipes.title: Recipes
guide.aptitudes.recipes.body:
Bonfire: iron sword / cobblestone + campfire + cobblestone.
Grimoire: book + gold nugget.
Rebirth Offering: 3 Soul Shards + gold ingot + candle.
Estus Flask: bottle + 2 shards + blaze powder + gold ingot.
Ether Flask: bottle + 2 shards + lapis lazuli + amethyst shard.
Soul tool: diamond tool + 3 shards.
Role armor: piece pattern with the role material + a shard in the center.
Mastery Emblem: gold, diamonds and an emerald block.
Ultimate Core: echo shards, dragon's breath, diamond blocks and a nether star.
Soul Shard: 1 echo shard → 2.
Guild Desk: 2 gold + emerald + 5 planks.
Accessories: see the Accessories chapter.
The game's recipe book shows all the others.
guide.aptitudes.drops.title: Loot
guide.aptitudes.drops.body:
Soul Shard: 5%% of monsters killed by a player (+1%% per luck point); 4 from each boss (Wither, Dragon, Warden, Elder Guardian).
Elites: 1-2 shards, Elite Essence (50%%) and more XP.
Champions: 4-6 shards, Champion Heart, 2-3 Essences and a role armor piece.
Tower, shrine and camp chests: shards, flasks, role items, armor, soul tools, accessories, Offerings and Emblems.
Guild villager: almost all of the above for emeralds.

guide.aptitudes.paths.title: Paths and keystones
guide.aptitudes.paths.body:
Each role has three paths: A, B and C. Learning the first rank chooses ONE and locks the other two. Reset the tree to change paths.

In J, the «Paths» button opens the selected role’s full path view: A/B/C tabs, levels, requirements and confirmation when choosing. S1–S3 also appear in the tree grid.

SEVEN STEPS (default levels):
S1: 10; S2: 14; S3: 20; S4: 26.
S5: level 32, a fork between S5x/S5y: you may learn only ONE branch.
S6: level 40; requires either S5 branch and repeats S4’s effect at ×1.5 strength.
S7: keystone, level 50, a single rank; requires S6.
S1–S6 allow three ranks, each requiring five more levels. Each rank costs one point.

KEYSTONES: every path has one of these ten templates. Learning S7 activates it in your primary or secondary role, with an indicator on the HUD. Default values below; the server can change them:

Carnage: on kill, restore 10%% of your maximum health and gain Haste II for 5 s.

Bulwark: below 30%% health, gain Absorption II (8 points) and Resistance I for 6 s; 60 s cooldown.

Tempest: critical hits and 15%% of direct hits send a 3-damage spark to another enemy within 5 blocks; 1 s cooldown.

Overload: every fourth ability costs no mana and has half its normal cooldown.

Specter: +5%% dodge; after dodging, your next hit within 3 s is a guaranteed critical.

Detonation: on kill, deal 4 magic damage to enemies within 3 blocks; no chain detonations, block damage or harm to allies.

Contagion: on kill, spread the victim’s poison, slowness, wither and fire to 2 enemies within 4 blocks.

Sanctuary: every 5 s, heal yourself and allies within 8 blocks for 2 health points.

Fortune: on kill, a 25%% chance of an extra loot roll; elites also have a 10%% chance to drop an emerald.

Legion: +1 maximum minion; your minions heal you for 10%% of the damage they deal.
guide.aptitudes.achievements.title: Achievements
guide.aptitudes.achievements.body:
Open Minecraft’s advancements and select the «Aptitudes» tab. It contains 17 achievements, automatically granted by the server when their requirements are met. Hover over an advancement to read its objective.

BONFIRE AND PROGRESSION:
Rest at a Bonfire; reach soul level 10; choose a role; evolve to Master and then Ultimate; reach level 50 in a usage skill.

COMBAT AND EQUIPMENT:
Perform a combo finisher; socket a rune; defeat a custom boss and the Eclipse Herald. The hit following a chain of five hits performs the finisher.

EVENTS:
Complete a Soul Fog, an Ember Rain and an Eclipse; each event has its own achievement. For the Eclipse, reach the end without dying.

PARTIES AND GUILD:
Form or join a party; claim your first contract; claim 10 contracts; reach Guild Master (700 reputation). Accepting a contract does not count as claiming it.

On joining, the server checks achievements based on saved state: role, evolution, soul level, skills and contracts. Older worlds can grant these without repeating that progress. Action achievements require performing the action; achievements already granted are not duplicated.
guide.aptitudes.eclipse.title: World events
guide.aptitudes.eclipse.body:
By default, every 10 days from day 10 the Overworld picks a random event: Eclipse, Soul Fog or Ember Rain. It never repeats the previous one. The bell the evening before announces which is coming; /aptitudes event shows the next event.

ECLIPSE:
Penumbra, 6:00–9:00: red sky and first waves.
Totality, 9:00–15:00: crimson ring, ash, more elites and champions. At 12:00 the Herald arrives near each group of players.
Retreat, 15:00–18:00: waves stop.

Creatures have more health, damage and, by default, +4 armour. They may wear chainmail in Penumbra, iron in Totality and diamond if they are champions. Totality adds another 25%% health and damage, and wither skeletons join the waves. Creatures dissolve when the event ends.

Elites, champions and the Herald drop Eclipse Fragments. The Herald drops the Eclipse Core, which upgrades evolution weapons at the Guild Desk. The Eclipse Rune defaults to +15%% damage against elites and bosses. Reaching the end without dying grants role and Combat XP.

SOUL FOG (18:00–6:00): grey fog and only undead: zombies, skeletons and their variants. Depending on the biome, drowned and bogged appear near water, husks in warm climates or strays in cold ones. They drop Soul Shards; no phantoms appear.

EMBER RAIN (6:00–18:00): small, large and huge meteors, visible before impact. Larger meteors have stronger explosions and more loot. They do not break blocks but can deal damage. They leave minerals and sometimes diamonds or netherite scrap; large and huge meteors also leave magma for 30 s. They may bring magma cubes, blazes, piglin brutes, hoglins and wither skeletons.

Values depend on the server configuration. Turn off the red sky in HUD settings (Shift + O).

guide.aptitudes.contracts.title: Guild Contracts
guide.aptitudes.contracts.body:
Place a CONTRACT BOARD and use it. Each Minecraft day offers you 3 contracts fixed for you (closing and reopening doesn't change them); the first offer is always of the highest difficulty you have.

You can carry 2 contracts at once (3 from Veteran). Each offer can only be accepted once per day. Contracts in progress don't expire.

TYPES: Hunt (your party's kills count too), Delivery (all at once, from your inventory), Fishing, Enchanting, Profession (XP in a skill), Forge (at the Guild Desk), Event (survive an Eclipse, Soul Fog or Ember Rain) and Boss (Legendary only; your party counts too).

DIFFICULTY: rises with reputation (Apprentice → Officer 100 → Veteran 300 → Master 700). With your primary role at Master, Elite contracts appear; at Ultimate, Legendary ones.

REWARDS: emeralds, primary role XP, reputation and, for the hardest, Soul Shards, armory vouchers or mastery emblems.

guide.aptitudes.alchemy.title: Alchemy
guide.aptitudes.alchemy.body:
Brew in a fueled brewing stand. The recipes below come from the game; hover over bottles and click the petals to view their extraction.

Mana restores energy; Frenzy speeds up attacks; Veil protects against event creatures; Vigor regenerates and nourishes.

A primary or secondary Herbalist within 8 blocks brews 50% faster and extends effects by 50%. Opening the stand lets them move up to 32 blocks away while online in that world. Doses do not add potency.

Only one Herbalist earns XP per batch: the player who opened the stand takes priority, then the nearest. The first three grant 4 base XP; repeated batches within five minutes reduce XP to zero. Taking bottles or reopening never pays again. Creative and spectator players do not qualify. These values are configurable.
